description: This file defines a Twig extension class 'StringLoaderExtension' that adds a function to load templates from strings within the Twig templating engine.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\StringLoaderExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension that provides a function 'template_from_string' to create templates from strings.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig functions added by this extension, notably 'template_from_string'.

methods.name: templateFromString
methods.description: A static method that creates a Twig template from a string input, using the environment.
